automotive-ev-battery.title: IONNA opens 22-bay charging hub in California and adds Tesla Autocharge
automotive-ev-battery.summary: US charging network IONNA has opened a flagship 22-bay charging station in Westminster, California, with peak power output of 400 kW, marking a significant expansion of high-speed charging infrastructure. The opening coincides with the expansion of automatic charging authentication to Tesla vehicles, with support for Stellantis brands vehicles scheduled to follow in December.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Mercedes-Benz GLA test drive: compact SUV with 800-volt architecture and two-tonne towing capacity
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The new Mercedes-Benz GLA 350 4MATIC electric demonstrates advanced engineering with its 800-volt architecture, 85-kWh battery, and two-speed transmission, delivering high efficiency and reduced charging times in the competitive compact electric SUV segment. The vehicle combines practical features including a large frunk, two-ton towing capacity, and the new MB.OS operating system.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Allego secures financing package of up to €720 million euros
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Dutch charging infrastructure operator Allego has announced a financing package worth nearly €720 million to support its expansion operations. The substantial funding reflects the company's significant capital requirements, particularly as it pursues expansion into the UK market.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Subaru E-Outback to launch in UK from £49,995
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Subaru has confirmed UK pricing for its new all-electric flagship, the E-Outback, with the electric SUV starting at £49,995 across four trim levels. Initial customer deliveries are scheduled for early 2027.

automotive-ev-battery.title: The Mayor of the East Midlands is Backing a £47.55 Million Investment to Bring 189 Battery-Electric Buses
automotive-ev-battery.summary: The East Midlands Combined County Authority has approved a £47.55 million investment to introduce 189 battery-electric buses to replace older diesel vehicles and improve regional air quality. The funding will cover the acquisition of new buses and associated charging infrastructure.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Changan Subsidiary Avatr Expands into Switzerland
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Chinese automaker Avatr, a Changan subsidiary, is expanding into the Swiss market with its 07L and 06T models scheduled for 2027, with distribution handled by Kamps Import AG and Schmohl AG. Vehicles will be priced from approximately 59,900 CHF (€65,500) with spring 2027 delivery anticipated.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Kim Long Motor delivers 100 electric sleeper buses in Vietnam
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Vietnamese electric commercial vehicle manufacturer Kim Long Motor has delivered a fleet of 100 electric sleeper buses to Futa Bus Lines, a major domestic operator based in Ho Chi Minh City. The vehicles are now in service on intercity routes, demonstrating growing adoption of electric transportation in Southeast Asia.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Nissan recognises Aviloo's battery tests
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Nissan Automotive Europe has officially recognized Austrian battery diagnostics specialist Aviloo as an independent provider for assessing battery condition in used electric vehicles. Aviloo's battery certificates can now be incorporated into Nissan's Certified Pre-Owned program, enhancing transparency in the secondhand EV market.

automotive-ev-battery.title: UK energy price cap increase could add up to £9 to EV charging costs
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Rising energy prices in the UK from January 2027 threaten to increase home EV charging costs by up to £9, potentially eroding some cost advantages of electric vehicle ownership. The impact will vary significantly depending on individual suppliers and tariffs, with households on standard variable rate deals facing the greatest immediate pressure.

automotive-ev-battery.title: Stagecoach brings 21 electric buses into service in North Devon
automotive-ev-battery.summary: Stagecoach South West has deployed 21 battery-electric buses in North Devon, marking the first phase of its broader electric bus rollout across the region. The vehicles have entered service from the operator's Barnstaple depot, following earlier deployments in Exeter and Torbay.

world-news.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
world-news.summary: Ukraine's President Zelensky has expressed frustration with the United States, stating it is concentrating insufficiently on pressuring Russia and questioning the appropriateness of Trump's characterization of Vladimir Putin as a friend. The statement reflects ongoing tensions between Kyiv and Washington regarding US foreign policy priorities in the Ukraine-Russia conflict.

world-news.title: Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges Putin to 'pull back'
world-news.summary: Ukrainian President Zelenskyy has warned of an imminent major Russian military offensive as President Trump claims he has urged Putin to reduce military aggression in Europe. The statement underscores escalating tensions between Russian and Ukrainian forces and divergent diplomatic approaches.

world-news.title: Estonia closing land borders with Russia to keep out spies
world-news.summary: Estonia has announced plans to close its land border crossings with Russia by December 1 as part of heightened security measures against espionage. The move reflects NATO member concerns regarding Russian intelligence operations and hybrid warfare tactics in the Baltic region.

world-news.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
world-news.summary: Two Italian technicians working for German defense contractor Rheinmetall were killed in a strike in Kuwait, with Iran denying involvement in the attack. The incident highlights ongoing regional tensions and security risks for foreign nationals operating in the Middle East.

world-news.title: Trump downplays Russia, China support for Iran during talks with US troops
world-news.summary: President Trump has minimized concerns regarding Russian and Chinese military support for Iran while addressing US troops deployed to the Gulf region. The remarks reflect Trump's approach to geopolitical challenges in the Middle East and broader great power competition.

world-news.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
world-news.summary: New Zealand's right-leaning National Party-led coalition has fallen short of securing a parliamentary majority by one seat following recent elections. The outcome creates significant uncertainty regarding government formation and policy direction in the country.

world-news.title: New Zealand's Opportunity Party poised to become election kingmaker
world-news.summary: New Zealand's newly-elected Opportunity Party now holds a pivotal position to determine whether parliament swings toward the political left or right. The party's coalition decision will be instrumental in determining government formation and policy priorities.

world-news.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
world-news.summary: At least thirteen soldiers from Niger's National Guard were killed in an armed attack in Tillaberi near the Mali border, with the perpetrators remaining unidentified. The attack underscores ongoing security challenges in the Sahel region amid persistent militant and bandit activities.

world-news.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
world-news.summary: A German boat dealer is suspected of supplying small boats and engines used by migrant smuggling gangs operating in the English Channel, with allegedly nearly one-third of early 2026 crossings involving his products. The discovery highlights transnational human trafficking networks and cross-border law enforcement challenges.

world-news.title: Asian stock markets rise after earlier tech rout
world-news.summary: Stock indices in Japan, South Korea, Australia, and Hong Kong experienced gains following earlier technology sector declines, while New Zealand markets dipped amid election-related uncertainty. The movement reflects broader investor sentiment and regional economic responses to global market volatility.

science-space.title: Has AI just cracked Internet encryption? Rumoured 'bombshell' stuns scientists
science-space.summary: Scientists are examining claims that artificial intelligence may have compromised widely-used internet encryption protocols, potentially representing a significant breakthrough in computational cryptography. The alleged development has generated considerable attention within the research community pending peer review and verification of the findings.

science-space.title: Chromosome 'glue' could boost fertility by stabilizing ageing eggs
science-space.summary: Researchers have identified a molecular mechanism that stabilizes aging eggs through a protein complex acting as chromosome 'glue,' offering potential therapeutic applications for enhancing fertility in older women. This discovery could have significant implications for reproductive medicine and assisted reproductive technologies.

science-space.title: Rocket Lab sending Japanese satellite to orbit on Thanksgiving Day launch
science-space.summary: Rocket Lab is preparing to launch a Japanese satellite for Synspective, marking the company's 14th mission for the Tokyo-based Earth observation firm. The Thanksgiving Day launch demonstrates continued commercial space activity and international partnership in satellite deployment.

science-space.title: On this day in space! Nov. 26, 2011: NASA's 2-ton nuclear-powered Curiosity rover launches to Mars
science-space.summary: NASA's Curiosity rover, a two-ton nuclear-powered rover, launched toward Mars on November 26, 2011, marking a pivotal moment in planetary exploration. The mission has since become one of the most successful and productive Mars missions in history.

science-space.title: Venus shines at its brightest in the predawn sky this week
science-space.summary: Venus reaches peak brightness in the predawn sky this week, providing an excellent opportunity for skywatchers to observe Earth's neighboring planet at its most brilliant. The article provides guidance on locating the planet during optimal viewing conditions.

science-space.title: Cosmic 'betta fish' glows in spectacular nebula portrait
science-space.summary: The Dark Energy Camera has captured a striking image of the Betta Fish Nebula, showcasing brilliant blue coloration across the cosmic landscape. The photograph highlights the visual beauty of deep-space astronomical observations.

science-space.title: APOD: 2026 November 26 – Eye in the Sky: The Milky Way over Lençóis
science-space.summary: NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day features a compelling image of the Milky Way captured over Lençóis, with professional astronomical explanation provided. The image exemplifies the agency's daily commitment to sharing cosmic photography with the public.

science-space.title: Orangutans face bleak future after Indonesia's devastating wildfires
science-space.summary: Indonesia's recent wildfires have created severe threats to orangutan populations and their habitat, with significant conservation implications for the endangered species. The environmental crisis underscores the critical need for wildlife protection measures in Southeast Asia.

science-space.title: Every smart telescope reviewed and highly rated that is cheaper for Black Friday
science-space.summary: Multiple manufacturers including Unistellar, ZWO, Vaonis, and Dwarflab are offering significant Black Friday discounts on smart telescopes, making advanced astronomical observation tools more accessible to consumers. The sales provide entry-level and intermediate options for astronomy enthusiasts.

science-space.title: NASA+ Content Coming to Big Screen at Greenbelt, Maryland Cinema
science-space.summary: NASA announced that NASA+ streaming content will be featured theatrically at The Greenbelt Cinema in Maryland, expanding the agency's reach to new audiences through traditional cinema venues. The initiative fulfills NASA's mandate to share space exploration stories broadly while increasing public engagement with agency content.

tech-ai.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
tech-ai.summary: Nvidia has instructed manufacturing partners to halt server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia as part of U.S. efforts to prevent advanced AI chips from reaching China. This move reflects escalating geopolitical tensions and regulatory pressure surrounding semiconductor exports to Asia.

tech-ai.title: Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
tech-ai.summary: Google announced a policy requiring independent Android app developers to publicly disclose phone numbers and addresses starting next year to comply with European Union's Digital Services Act. The requirement has raised privacy concerns among developers, though Google plans to enforce the change globally with a February 1, 2027 deadline.

tech-ai.title: X finally gets parental controls after 20 years
tech-ai.summary: Elon Musk's social network X has introduced parental controls for teenage users, enabling parents and guardians to manage content visibility on the platform. The feature addresses long-standing requests for child safety mechanisms on the social media platform.

tech-ai.title: Federal judge blocks the FCC from reviewing ABC's licenses early
tech-ai.summary: A U.S. District Judge has blocked the Federal Communications Commission from conducting an early review of ABC's broadcast licenses and rejected motions to dismiss the network's First Amendment lawsuit. The judge indicated ABC is likely to succeed in its retaliation claim against the FCC.

tech-ai.title: Grand Theft Auto VI proves why efficiency isn't a virtue
tech-ai.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI became one of the most successful entertainment launches of all time, demonstrating the value of painstaking human craftsmanship over algorithmic efficiency. The timing coincided with Anthropic's public market entry, highlighting the contrast between AI-driven optimization and artisanal game development.

tech-ai.title: GTA VI developers vote against unionization
tech-ai.summary: Workers at Rockstar Games voted against unionization, with only 25 percent supporting a formal recognition agreement from the Independent Workers Union of Great Britain. Despite the failed vote, union organizers indicated they would continue organizing efforts among Rockstar employees.

tech-ai.title: The canceled Tesla Cybertruck is the fastest-selling used truck in America
tech-ai.summary: Despite its controversial design and production challenges, the Tesla Cybertruck became the fastest-selling used truck in America, averaging just 39.1 days on the market compared to the industry average of 65.5 days. The strong used-market performance underscores demand for the unconventional vehicle.

tech-ai.title: Why GTA VI's version of Florida feels so real
tech-ai.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI's fictional rendition of Florida stands as the studio's most lifelike setting, featuring functioning buses and trains, explorable buildings, and meticulous environmental detail. The exceptional sense of place contributes significantly to the game's massive appeal alongside its anticipated release and relatable characters.

tech-ai.title: A month with the iPhone Duo has changed how I use my phone
tech-ai.summary: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo has demonstrated meaningful impacts on user behavior, including increased book reading and reduced mindless scrolling habits. The device's unique form factor has prompted users to reconsider their daily digital consumption patterns.

tech-ai.title: European spacecraft finds chaotic scene after asteroid deflection experiment
tech-ai.summary: Europe's Hera mission has observed the aftermath of NASA's DART asteroid deflection experiment, revealing an unexpectedly chaotic impact site. The findings provide valuable scientific data on the consequences of kinetic impact technology for planetary defense.

finance-markets.title: Chinese households shed trillions in consumer debt
finance-markets.summary: Chinese households are reducing consumer debt as a three-year decline in mortgage borrowing extends to other consumer loans, signaling weakening domestic demand. This deleveraging trend reflects broader economic challenges in China's consumption-driven recovery.

finance-markets.title: Tech stocks set for worst month in four years as volatility surges
finance-markets.summary: Technology stocks face their worst monthly performance in four years as market volatility disrupts the dominant artificial intelligence trade and investors struggle to price future earnings accurately. The sharp reversal underscores growing uncertainty in the tech sector.

finance-markets.title: China Stocks Rally After Rare Midday Statement on Market Support
finance-markets.summary: Chinese equities rallied following an unusual mid-day statement from the State Council reaffirming support for the capital market and pledging additional supportive policies. The rare intervention highlights government commitment to stabilizing markets amid economic headwinds.

finance-markets.title: The US and Europe have opposite economic problems
finance-markets.summary: The United States and Europe face divergent economic challenges, with wealth hoarding among the rich constraining growth in America while stagnation threatens the European middle class. These structural differences require distinct policy responses from policymakers in each region.

finance-markets.title: Stocks Extend Recovery on AI Trade, Treasuries Dip: Markets Wrap
finance-markets.summary: Global equities extended gains into a second consecutive day as investor appetite returned to artificial intelligence-related stocks following weeks of heightened volatility. Bond yields rose as improved risk sentiment reduced safe-haven demand for Treasury securities.

finance-markets.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 27
finance-markets.summary: Oil prices tracked toward their first weekly gain this month as escalating attacks on Middle Eastern energy infrastructure and shipping tankers raised concerns about potential export disruptions. Geopolitical tensions continue to support crude valuations amid broader market uncertainty.

finance-markets.title: 'A changed man.' How will Jensen Huang lead Nvidia now?
finance-markets.summary: Questions surround whether Nvidia's management structure and corporate governance will be reformed under Jensen Huang's continued leadership, with employees, analysts, and legal experts expressing concerns. The inquiry reflects broader corporate accountability issues at the semiconductor giant.

finance-markets.title: Mahanadi Coalfields Shares Flat in Debut After $969 Million IPO
finance-markets.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields Ltd. began trading near its initial public offering price in its debut on the National Stock Exchange following a 969 million dollar listing. The muted market reception marks the first major IPO since Indian regulators prohibited gray-market pricing disclosures.

finance-markets.title: Treasuries Retreat as Gains in Equities Sap Demand for Havens
finance-markets.summary: Treasury prices fell in light holiday trading as rising equity markets reduced investor demand for safe-haven assets following the Thanksgiving break. The sell-off reflects improving risk sentiment across global markets.

finance-markets.title: Kalshi's next big bet: 'microinsurance' for small businesses
finance-markets.summary: Financial platform Kalshi is pivoting toward microinsurance products for small businesses to offset declining revenues from sports wagering amid mounting regulatory pressures. The expansion into conventional financial services represents a strategic diversification for the prediction markets operator.

health-biotech.title: Sanofi, with $41B Insmed buy, inks year's biggest biopharma acquisition
health-biotech.summary: Sanofi announced a $41 billion acquisition of Insmed, marking the largest biopharma deal of the year and a significant strategic bet to strengthen its immunology and rare disease portfolio. The acquisition includes two approved commercial drugs and a pipeline of respiratory therapies, positioning Sanofi for major revenue growth beyond its blockbuster Dupixent product.

health-biotech.title: FDA clears Roche's oral SERD as treatment in early-stage breast cancer
health-biotech.summary: The FDA approved Roche's oral selective estrogen receptor degrader (SERD) for early-stage breast cancer treatment, representing a significant therapeutic advance in oncology. Analysts project the drug could become a multibillion-dollar product, addressing a substantial market opportunity in breast cancer care.

health-biotech.title: FDA approves BridgeBio muscular dystrophy drug
health-biotech.summary: The FDA approved BridgeBio's novel treatment for muscular dystrophy, with pricing set at nearly $1 million annually, marking an important therapeutic option for patients with limited treatment alternatives. Wall Street analysts project blockbuster sales potential for the medicine, which demonstrated improvements in patient mobility and respiratory function.

health-biotech.title: Lilly buys Huntington's drug developer LoQus23 in potentially $725M deal
health-biotech.summary: Eli Lilly acquired LoQus23 in a deal valued up to $725 million to gain access to a potentially first-in-class Huntington's disease treatment targeting the MSH3 protein. The acquisition represents Lilly's strategic expansion into neurodegenerative diseases and addresses a significant unmet medical need in genetic neurological disorders.

health-biotech.title: In a fertility advance, engineered molecular glue stabilizes chromosomes in aging eggs
health-biotech.summary: Researchers developed an engineered protein system that can restore normal chromosome connections in aging mouse eggs, offering a potential breakthrough for improving fertility outcomes in women of advanced maternal age. The finding raises hopes for future applications in IVF treatments and understanding age-related reproductive decline.

health-biotech.title: Kymera eczema pill meets goals in mid-stage trial
health-biotech.summary: Kymera's oral protein degrader drug achieved efficacy comparable to biologic treatments in a Phase 2 trial for eczema, positioning it as a potential competitive threat to Sanofi and Regeneron's market-leading Dupixent. The result supports the company's claim that the small-molecule approach could offer patients an alternative treatment modality.

health-biotech.title: FDA approves Cogent's drug for rare stomach cancer
health-biotech.summary: The FDA granted clearance to Cogent Biosciences for a novel stomach cancer treatment designed to be used in combination with Pfizer's Sutent, expanding therapeutic options for this rare malignancy. The approval marks a significant milestone for Cogent and addresses an area of oncology with limited treatment alternatives.

health-biotech.title: FDA again turns back Capricor Duchenne cell therapy
health-biotech.summary: The FDA rejected Capricor's deramiocel cell therapy for Duchenne muscular dystrophy for the second time, citing serious data integrity violations that compromised study findings. The rejection highlights regulatory scrutiny around data quality in cell and gene therapy development and represents a significant setback for the company's Duchenne treatment program.

health-biotech.title: Pharming pauses Ruconest production, warns of supply interruption
health-biotech.summary: Pharming announced a production halt for its marketed hereditary angioedema drug Ruconest due to manufacturing issues at a third-party facility, with the company notifying the FDA of potential supply disruptions. The pause could impact patient access to treatment for this rare genetic disorder.

health-biotech.title: Bayer goes to Hansoh for ADC deal worth $150M up front
health-biotech.summary: Bayer entered a partnership with Chinese biotech firm Hansoh Pharma for antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) development, with $150 million upfront, as dealmaking with China's biotech industry continues to accelerate. The collaboration reflects major pharmaceutical companies' continued interest in accessing innovative early-stage assets from Chinese developers.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Used Optimizely to A/B Test Malware on Top Websites
cybersecurity.summary: A security vulnerability in Optimizely's platform allowed attackers to inject malware into at least 178 major websites including BBC, CNN, Equifax, Ledger, and Zoom over a 24-hour period. The incident exposed millions of users to data-stealing malicious software and was compounded by the lack of strict content source enforcement across popular websites.

cybersecurity.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
cybersecurity.summary: A pair of critical vulnerabilities in PHP core software affect nearly 70 percent of websites and allow attackers to seize full control of affected servers. Working exploits for these flaws are already being actively exploited in the wild, potentially causing widespread site outages.

cybersecurity.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
cybersecurity.summary: Drupal has disclosed a highly critical vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-136716 that allows site takeover and is currently being exploited in the wild. The flaw relates to improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions and addresses remaining vulnerable installation states.

cybersecurity.title: North Korea-Linked PolinRider Poisons Over 7,600 GitHub Repositories to Spread Malware
cybersecurity.summary: A North Korea-linked threat group has planted Python loaders in over 7,600 GitHub repositories as part of the PolinRider campaign, with evidence suggesting the activity began in February 2025. The malware hides within utility packages and conftest.py files, activating when Python imports the files.

cybersecurity.title: Who Runs the Ransomware Group Qilin?
cybersecurity.summary: Cybercrime group Qilin has become the world's most active ransomware affiliate program with at least 365 victim organizations claimed in the past three months. Security researchers have attributed the group's administration to a 36-year-old man in St. Petersburg, Russia, based on operational security mistakes made over the past decade.

cybersecurity.title: Tech Firms Dismantle Botnet That Turned 1.3M TV Boxes Into Proxies
cybersecurity.summary: Google and industry partners have successfully dismantled a botnet comprising over 1.3 million Android TV set-top boxes that were secretly harvesting internet connections and conducting advertising fraud. The takedown is expected to sever access to more than 10 million additional compromised IoT systems, including Android-based healthcare devices.

cybersecurity.title: CTO of 'RansomwareHelp' Indicted for Wire Fraud
cybersecurity.summary: The chief technology officer and co-founder of ransomwarehelp.com has been indicted for wire fraud after an FBI sting operation revealed the company was simply purchasing decryption keys from attackers and charging victims inflated markups for non-existent recovery services. The six-year-old Florida business falsely claimed to use advanced cryptographic tools to restore ransomware-locked data.

cybersecurity.title: Attackers Target .NET Developers With Poisoned Job Assessments
cybersecurity.summary: Researchers discovered 13 malicious NuGet packages distributed as part of a fake recruitment campaign designed to compromise .NET developers. The poisoned packages deliver malware that grants attackers unauthorized access to developers' machines and sensitive development environments.

cybersecurity.title: Hackers Exploit 10 Vulnerabilities Across Mitel, Juniper, Vates, and Danfoss Products
cybersecurity.summary: CISA added 10 security flaws to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, including five critical vulnerabilities in Mitel MiCollab that are being actively exploited by threat actors. The vulnerabilities span multiple vendors and include arbitrary file upload issues with CVSS scores ranging from moderate to critical.

cybersecurity.title: Webworm APT Slithers Into Networks With Customized SoftEther VPN
cybersecurity.summary: A China-aligned espionage group has rebuilt the open-source SoftEther VPN software from source code, stripping forensic artifacts that would normally expose it to security defenders. This customization allows the Webworm APT to maintain persistent access to compromised networks while evading detection mechanisms.

crypto-web3.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
crypto-web3.summary: Binance has announced the complete restoration of customer withdrawals following its October $6.3 billion security breach, marking a significant milestone in the exchange's recovery efforts. While a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance, the lifting of withdrawal suspensions indicates the exchange has resolved critical operational constraints stemming from the hack.

crypto-web3.title: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
crypto-web3.summary: Spain's anti-money laundering authority, Sepblac, has been granted expanded authority to freeze cryptocurrency accounts without judicial approval, strengthening the country's regulatory enforcement mechanisms. This regulatory shift represents a significant expansion of government powers over crypto financial activity beyond existing protocols requiring foreign financial intelligence unit requests.

crypto-web3.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs on track for worst month on record as bear market drags on
crypto-web3.summary: Spot bitcoin ETFs are experiencing record monthly net outflows of $5.39 billion in November as the cryptocurrency continues its bear market downturn. With several trading days remaining in the month, the funds are positioned to record their worst performance since inception, reflecting diminished investor confidence amid broader market weakness.

crypto-web3.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
crypto-web3.summary: Ripple's lending platform infrastructure is approaching deployment, with vaults scheduled to activate on December 9 to hold lender funds from the XRP Ledger's stablecoin supply. The underlying loan system requires approval from one additional validator before initiating its two-week operational timeline.

crypto-web3.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
crypto-web3.summary: Ethereum developers have approved proceeding with the Glamsterdam upgrade testing despite concerns about storage charges affecting some existing smart contracts, resolving delays that had stalled the initiative for seven weeks. The upgrade is now scheduled for a December test phase with the contentious storage fee structure preserved.

crypto-web3.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
crypto-web3.summary: Standard Chartered's cryptocurrency custody arm, Zodia Custody, experienced a data breach that exposed client and employee contact information. The institution confirmed that no unauthorized transactions occurred as a result of the breach, limiting the immediate financial impact.

crypto-web3.title: China, Japan, South Korea and ASEAN to form working group on digital payments, crypto regulation
crypto-web3.summary: Regional economic powers China, Japan, South Korea, and ASEAN member nations have established a collaborative working group to coordinate on digital payments infrastructure and cryptocurrency regulation. The initiative follows preliminary discussions held in May and reflects growing recognition of cross-border digital payment cooperation as a strategic priority.

crypto-web3.title: A tiny payment can expose the IP address behind a bitcoin wallet, developer finds
crypto-web3.summary: A Bitcoin Core contributor has identified a privacy vulnerability in Bitcoin wallets that allows anyone to link a wallet address to its associated computer by exploiting the wallet's payment-resend mechanism for a cost below 35 cents. The discovery highlights a previously underappreciated security weakness in wallet anonymity protections.

crypto-web3.title: Switzerland approves 57 jurisdictions for crypto data exchange from 2028
crypto-web3.summary: Switzerland's Federal Council has authorized 57 jurisdictions as approved partners for cryptoasset tax-information exchanges beginning in 2028, expanding the country's regulatory transparency framework. The approval signals Switzerland's commitment to international tax compliance standards within the cryptocurrency sector.

crypto-web3.title: Bitcoin's dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
crypto-web3.summary: Bitcoin holdings sitting dormant onchain have increased as the cryptocurrency maintains price levels around $60,000, representing a 50% decline from previous peaks. This accumulation pattern historically correlates with bear-market bottoming phases, potentially signaling a shift in market sentiment among longer-term holders.

startups-vc.title: Bending Spoons buys Mailchimp for $3.68B
startups-vc.summary: Italian software company Bending Spoons has acquired Mailchimp for $3.68 billion, representing a significant markdown from Intuit's $12 billion acquisition price in 2021. The deal signals potential consolidation in the marketing automation space and reflects current market valuations for established SaaS platforms.

startups-vc.title: The Week's 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: $400M For Neurotech Leads, Followed By Big Deals For AI, Fintech, Biotech And More
startups-vc.summary: Brain-computer interface company Science led the week's funding activity with a $400 million raise, reflecting strong investor appetite for neurotech alongside significant capital deployment across AI, fintech, and biotech sectors. The funding round demonstrates continued momentum in deep-tech and transformative technology categories.

startups-vc.title: 20VC x SaaStr: Anthropic's $1.5 Trillion IPO, Jensen Huang's Return, and Mailchimp Sells for Under a Third of What Intuit Paid
startups-vc.summary: A venture capital roundtable discusses major recent developments including Anthropic's anticipated $1.5 trillion IPO valuation, Jensen Huang's return at Nvidia, Mailchimp's discounted sale, and Cognition's $75 billion valuation. The episode covers critical M&A and capital market dynamics shaping the AI and SaaS landscape.

startups-vc.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
startups-vc.summary: Supertake has secured $20 million in funding to develop AI agents that automate portfolio construction based on user market predictions. The startup addresses the gap between investment conviction and execution, enabling users to implement their market views without requiring individual stock selection expertise.

startups-vc.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher's fusion power startup. Here's what they're building.
startups-vc.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek has invested in Europa Fusion, a fusion power startup founded by an AI researcher focused on advancing clean energy technology. The funding reflects prominent entrepreneur interest in deep-tech solutions addressing critical infrastructure needs.

startups-vc.title: Most Unicorns Are Worth More Than Their Last Funding-Round Valuations, Crunchbase Estimates
startups-vc.summary: Crunchbase's new Current Valuation Model estimates the combined value of over 1,900 unicorns at approximately $11 trillion, up significantly from their last reported valuations of $9 trillion. The analysis suggests substantial private company value creation since most recent funding rounds in a strong market environment.

startups-vc.title: What The Telecom Bust Taught Me About AI's Debt Boom
startups-vc.summary: A venture capital analyst draws parallels between the telecom industry's debt-fueled bubble and current AI infrastructure spending, warning that aggressive capital deployment could outpace revenue growth and create bankruptcy risks. The piece emphasizes the importance of realistic demand forecasts and sustainable cash flow models for AI-focused borrowers.

startups-vc.title: 5 Interesting Learnings from HubSpot as Brian Halligan Returns as CEO: A Refounding to Reaccelerate Growth
startups-vc.summary: HubSpot's co-founder Brian Halligan has resumed the CEO role at the $3.7 billion revenue company as of November 12, replacing Yamini Rangan in a strategic leadership transition. The move reflects efforts to reinvigorate growth at the established SaaS platform through founder-led direction.

startups-vc.title: 5 Interesting Startup Deals You May Have Missed: Reflecting Sunlight From Space, Better Breathing And Smarter Garbage Trucks
startups-vc.summary: A curated selection of emerging startup deals includes orbital mirror technology for solar farms, space-based research platforms, AI-powered waste management systems, factory automation software, and consumer health innovations. The roundup highlights diverse investment opportunities across climate tech, space tech, and industrial AI sectors.

startups-vc.title: The fallout from Nvidia's Jensen Huang scandal continues
startups-vc.summary: Nvidia has navigated the fallout from CEO Jensen Huang's ouster while delivering healthy earnings growth and announcing plans to discontinue H200 chip sales to China. The company's earnings report and strategic adjustments underscore ongoing governance challenges alongside operational resilience.

energy-climate.title: Analysis: Climate-finance pledges fall 70% as countries meet at COP31
energy-climate.summary: Public climate finance commitments to developing nations have declined by over 70 percent during COP31 negotiations in Antalya, Turkey, significantly undercutting global efforts to support climate action in vulnerable countries. The sharp reduction raises concerns about the adequacy of international support mechanisms for climate mitigation and adaptation initiatives.

energy-climate.title: COP31: Key outcomes agreed at the UN climate talks in Antalya
energy-climate.summary: COP31 climate negotiations in Antalya, Turkey have concluded without reaching agreement on a comprehensive climate pact, with significant gaps remaining in key policy commitments. The failed consensus on binding climate measures represents a setback for international climate governance.

energy-climate.title: India adds 11.2 GW of rooftop PV capacity in first nine months of 2026
energy-climate.summary: India's rooftop solar capacity surged by 11.2 gigawatts in the first three quarters of 2026, with residential installations accounting for over 95 percent of additions, bringing cumulative installed rooftop capacity to 32 GW. The expansion has been driven primarily by the government's PM Surya Ghar residential solar subsidy program.

energy-climate.title: France triples planned renewable energy auction volume to 1.5 GW
energy-climate.summary: France has expanded its upcoming technology-neutral renewable energy auction from 500 megawatts to 1.5 gigawatts, opening procurement to all renewable power technologies with a unified baseload reference price mechanism. The tripled capacity represents a significant acceleration of France's renewable energy deployment strategy.

energy-climate.title: Google signs PPA to buy 50MW geothermal power from Quaise Energy
energy-climate.summary: Google has executed a power purchase agreement to acquire 50 megawatts of geothermal energy from Quaise Energy's Project Obsidian development in Central Oregon, expanding the technology giant's renewable energy portfolio. The agreement demonstrates growing corporate interest in geothermal as a reliable, dispatchable clean energy source.

energy-climate.title: Spain could reach 10 GW of batteries by 2030, but bankability remains the major challenge
energy-climate.summary: Spain's energy storage sector is projected to reach 10 gigawatts of installed battery capacity by 2030, though experts warn that financing challenges, lack of proven revenue models, and administrative complexities could impede growth. The assessment highlights the critical role of battery storage in enabling higher renewable energy penetration in the Spanish grid.

energy-climate.title: Gambia signs four solar PPAs totalling 232 MW
energy-climate.summary: Gambia's state-owned utility has signed four large-scale solar power purchase agreements totaling 232 megawatts since late October, with battery storage integrated into each project. The agreements represent significant progress in West African renewable energy development and energy security.

energy-climate.title: Peñoles and Atlas sign 20-year solar and storage deal in Mexico
energy-climate.summary: Mexican mining company Peñoles has signed a 20-year renewable energy agreement with Atlas Renewable Energy to develop a solar and battery storage project in Coahuila. The long-term procurement contract reflects growing corporate demand for renewable energy in Mexico's industrial sector.

energy-climate.title: Rare periods of low PV generation can be managed with storage
energy-climate.summary: Research from Germany's DIW Berlin indicates that battery energy storage systems combined with underground green hydrogen storage can effectively manage shortfalls in solar and wind generation during prolonged low renewable output periods. The analysis supports the viability of hybrid storage solutions in high-renewable grids.

energy-climate.title: Estonian solar park energized with 55 MW/250 MWh battery
energy-climate.summary: An Estonian hybrid solar facility has been equipped with a 55-megawatt/250-megawatt-hour battery energy storage system, the largest by capacity in the Baltic region to date, paired with an operational 77.5-megawatt solar farm. The installation demonstrates the feasibility of large-scale storage deployment in northern European renewable energy projects.

asia-pacific.title: Singapore reaches out to local firms amid reports of Nvidia chip shipment halt
asia-pacific.summary: Singapore's government is engaging with local businesses following reports that the United States has halted Nvidia server shipments to four Southeast Asian countries due to tightened export controls on advanced AI chips. Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong acknowledged the engagement but could not confirm the halt, citing ongoing US restrictions on advanced semiconductor exports based on national security concerns.

asia-pacific.title: What will Taiwan local elections reveal about 2028 race and cross-strait shifts?
asia-pacific.summary: Taiwan's local elections on Saturday will serve as a midterm test for President William Lai Ching-te and provide Beijing insight into shifting public sentiment and Taiwan's political trajectory ahead of the 2028 presidential race. Analysts suggest the results may influence city-level cross-strait exchanges and reflect voter sentiment on key governance issues.

asia-pacific.title: Will Taiwan's referendum bring back nuclear power as chips and AI strain the grid?
asia-pacific.summary: Taiwan's growing electricity demand from its semiconductor and artificial intelligence industries has elevated a nuclear power referendum into prominence during Saturday's local elections. The vote offers President William Lai Ching-te a potential political solution to the administration's exploration of nuclear revival, despite decades of opposition from his ruling Democratic Progressive Party.

asia-pacific.title: Is the Philippines Isolated Within ASEAN?
asia-pacific.summary: The article examines the Philippines' distinct diplomatic positioning within ASEAN, particularly regarding its approach to managing relations with China and Japan. The analysis suggests subtle differences in the Philippines' stance compared to other regional members on key strategic and security issues.

asia-pacific.title: Relief for Japan's Takaichi as scandal-hit education chief survives censure motion
asia-pacific.summary: Japan's upper house narrowly rejected a censure motion against Education Minister Yoshihiro Seki over controversial fundraising events attended by bureaucrats, providing temporary relief for Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's government. The nonbinding motion was defeated 124-120, easing immediate pressure for Seki's resignation and offering political breathing room for the administration.

asia-pacific.title: South Korean Chief Justice's Impending Impeachment
asia-pacific.summary: South Korea faces significant political and constitutional questions as impeachment proceedings loom against the Chief Justice, drawing public discourse on the separation of powers. The case reflects broader institutional tensions within South Korea's governance structure.

asia-pacific.title: Is the North Korean Economy Really 'Booming'?
asia-pacific.summary: Analysis of North Korea's economic narrative reveals a complex picture beyond claims of robust growth, examining the actual state of the country's economic development and sustainability. The assessment provides nuanced context for understanding North Korea's economic trajectory and international economic positioning.

asia-pacific.title: Nepal's Prime Minister Is Back From India. Now Comes the Hard Part.
asia-pacific.summary: Nepal's Prime Minister Balendra Shah has returned from India with numerous commitments from New Delhi, though questions remain regarding actual implementation of these agreements. The analysis examines the gap between diplomatic pledges and concrete policy outcomes in India-Nepal relations.

asia-pacific.title: How Can Australia Secure Its Future?
asia-pacific.summary: Australia's Foreign Minister has articulated a strategic vision for navigating rapid geopolitical and economic changes, rejecting both fatalism and nostalgia in favor of pragmatic policy approaches. The framework addresses Australia's positioning within the evolving Asia-Pacific security and economic environment.

asia-pacific.title: Huawei guilty on 10 counts in US trial; Nvidia's Jensen Huang returns: SCMP's 7 highlights
asia-pacific.summary: A weekly roundup of significant regional stories includes Huawei's conviction on ten counts in a US trial and updates on major technology industry developments including Nvidia leadership. The compilation highlights key developments affecting China's technology sector and broader Asia-Pacific business environment.
